title: Personal Training Packages: package pause availability, maximum pause length, and pause fee by tier
content:
## Scope
This document covers the Personal Training Packages product line and states, for every tier, whether the package may be paused, the maximum number of days it may remain paused, and the fee charged to pause it. How the expiration date is adjusted once a paused package resumes is stated in the package pause policy document, not here.

## Tier reference table

| Tier | Pause allowed | Maximum pause length (days) | Pause fee (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Single Session Pack | Yes | 30 | 0.00 |
| 5-Session Starter Pack | Yes | 30 | 0.00 |
| 10-Session Value Pack | Yes | 45 | 0.00 |
| 20-Session Performance Pack | Yes | 60 | 0.00 |
| Unlimited Monthly Coaching | Yes | 15 | 25.00 |
| Elite Specialty Coaching | Yes | 60 | 0.00 |

## Points of reference
Every tier of Personal Training Packages allows the package to be paused. Unlimited Monthly Coaching sets both the shortest maximum pause length, at 15 days, and the only nonzero pause fee, at 25.00 dollars; every other tier charges no fee to pause and allows longer maximum pause lengths, ranging from 30 days on the two entry tiers up to 60 days on 20-Session Performance Pack and Elite Specialty Coaching.
